name: studio_runtime
summary: The runtime spine. Reads a workflow_card, topo-orders its passes via declared in/out dependencies, dispatches each pass to the right substrate (deterministic / mcp / diffusers / comfyui / blender / remotion), anchors every step with a pass_crystal, emits all declared surfaces via workflow_generator, and logs the full TraceRecord to the crystal chain with tier='runtime'. Strings every substrate together into one callable spine.
engine_pattern: card_dict → topo_order_passes (Kahn) → for each pass → engine-specific dispatcher → PassTrace → workflow_generator.generate_all → surface artifacts → inference_logger.log

pass_engine_dispatchers.deterministic: pure-Python substrate calls (pinterest_harvest, svg_embed, light_source, spatial_anchor, frame_clock, transition_field, dataset_select)
pass_engine_dispatchers.mcp: deferred to mcp_bridge (op_mcp_bridge placeholder) — stamps trace, waits for #31
pass_engine_dispatchers.diffusers: deferred to task_queue GPU pool — when model_path exists on disk
pass_engine_dispatchers.blender: deferred to blender --background --python OR blender_mcp connector

substrate: trace records logged to ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl with tier='runtime'

outbound_calls: ops_dag (resolves pass order via declared in/out)
workflow_generator (emits the 7 declared surfaces from the card)
svg_vector_embed / light_source / frame_clock / spatial_anchor / transition_field (deterministic substrates)
inference_logger.log (every TraceRecord becomes a crystal-chain entry)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: all 8 surface paths declared in the card + crystal chain

the_spine_principle: Every workflow_card declares passes + surfaces. studio_runtime maps each pass to its dispatcher, each surface to workflow_generator. Cards become callable pipelines; the runtime IS the engine. When the friend runs `cc studio-run realestate_walkthrough_full`, every substrate participates and the trace_crystal records the whole event.
guarantees: Deterministic — same card + same chain state → same trace, byte-exact (modulo external API timestamps)
Cycle-tolerant — Kahn's algorithm appends cycle remainders deterministically
Substrate-agnostic — adding a new engine kind = new dispatcher method, no schema change
Crystal-anchored — every PassTrace + TraceRecord crystal-hashes for replay/audit
Graceful — IN-FLIGHT and STUB passes skip cleanly without breaking the trace
usage_example:
cd /data/Projects/MySpace++ && python3 core/lib/studio_runtime.py run realestate_walkthrough_full
# or via cc:
cc studio-run realestate_walkthrough_full --dry-run
cc studio-run realestate_walkthrough_full
